title: Lobby music: Ascension excerpts (mallsoft loop)
author: 식료품groceries
description: A 204 s mono loop for a hotel lobby at night: three 70 s excerpts of 식료품groceries, 인터넷 쇼핑 (Ascension) (2017), "Add To Cart" from 40 s, "Continue Shopping" from 15 s and "Quick-Start Guide" from 30 s, crossfaded over 3 s, loudness-normalised to -18 LUFS, 48 kbps MP3. Source: https://archive.org/details/ascension-raw-flac (CC0, published by the artist).

title: Hotel and Restaurant Workers (150 s, film soundtrack)
author: Prelinger Archives
description: 150 s of the soundtrack of the vocational film Hotel and Restaurant Workers, from 120 s; mono, 40 kbps MP3, loudness-normalised. Public domain, Prelinger Archives via the Internet Archive: https://archive.org/details/Hoteland.

title: Duck and Cover, 1951 (150 s, film soundtrack)
author: Federal Civil Defense Administration
description: 150 s of the soundtrack of Duck and Cover (1951), from 200 s; mono, 40 kbps MP3, loudness-normalised. US federal work, public domain; Prelinger Archives via the Internet Archive: https://archive.org/details/DuckandC1951.

title: Arctic Sentinels, Universal Newsreel 1956 (150 s)
author: Universal Newsreel
description: 150 s of the Universal Newsreel of 9 April 1956 (Arctic Sentinels: DEW Line radar), from 20 s; mono, 40 kbps MP3, loudness-normalised. Public domain via the Internet Archive: https://archive.org/details/1956-04-09_Arctic_Sentinels.
